links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM reports across repeated independent runs (test-retest stability, cosine similarity)
links.effect: High intra-case coherence across repeated LLM revisions (mean cosine similarity 0.599-0.727), regardless of authorship; high test-retest stability reported.
links.quote: The cosine similarity analysis revealed high intra-case coherence (mean: 0.599-0.727) regardless of authorship.

screen.reason: Empirical pilot study using simulated/textbook cases to evaluate the stability, quality, and expert blinded ratings of LLM-generated PET/CT follow-up reports compared to nuclear medicine residents.
